result.reason: The operative language satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the lower fallback limits. It is not minimal because it adds requirements beyond the preferred position, including a one-year post-term coverage period, an express at-own-expense obligation, and cyber/privacy coverage without limiting that obligation to circumstances in which IBM processes Customer Data. The existing risk-of-loss language remains unchanged, and no contradiction with it is introduced. The margin comment was not relied upon as operative language.
